body.interpretation: Non-zero-guarded 64-bit increment of the script-frame field at +0x20 (FFrame*): 0 stays 0, non-zero n becomes n+1. Then load the vtable pointer from [this] (RCX) and TAIL-CALL (JMP, not CALL) the virtual function at vtable byte offset 0xb40 (entry index 288). No other side effects, no return value. The reflected exec entry is only this frame side-effect plus the virtual dispatch; the real handler body lives in the vtable slot.

vtable_resolution.slot_target_meaning: Iterate the replicated TArray CutActors (data ptr byte 0x10a0, count byte 0x10a8, 0x60-byte entries). For each non-null entry: actor = entry+0x00; if the saved-state byte at entry+0x50 is non-zero, call AActor::SetActorEnableCollision(actor, true) [0x143f83090]; then call the virtual AActor::SetActorHiddenInGame(actor, false) [actor->vtable[0x2f8](actor, 0)] = unhide/restore. There is NO authority guard (restore runs on every machine).

set_actor_enable_collision.asm_summary: AActor::SetActorEnableCollision(bool bEnableCollision). First instruction reads AActor byte 0x5c, shifts right 2 and masks bit 0 to get bActorEnableCollision; if it already equals the argument it returns (no-op). Otherwise it sets byte 0x5c bit 2 to the argument and reapplies collision on the actor's components: it uses the STAT_GetComponentsTime scope (string at 0x1459bfb80), iterates the component array, and calls component->SetCollisionEnabled(...) (virtual 0x380) on each; also updates the root-component collision-enabled state (byte 0x14c / component 0x360/0x10/0x74).
set_actor_enable_collision.meaning: AActor::SetActorEnableCollision(bool). Called here with true (restore re-enables collision for actors that had it enabled when cut).

set_actor_hidden_in_game.asm_summary: Virtual call actor->vtable[0x2f8](actor, 0). In MulticastRestoreCutActors the second argument is 0 (false); in the sibling MulticastHideCutActors (slot 0xb48 = 0x14267b1b0) the same slot is called with 1 (true). The hide/restore pairing identifies it as AActor::SetActorHiddenInGame(bool bHidden).
set_actor_hidden_in_game.meaning: AActor::SetActorHiddenInGame(false) = unhide = restore the cut actor.
